title: Truncated expected hitting time
statement: Let $G$ be a finite directed graph, with target vertex $t$, starting vertex $s$, and natural number $N$. Define the truncated hitting time as the sum, over $0 \le j < N$, of one minus the probability of having hit $t$ within $j$ steps when starting at $s$.
